title: Export Operations Manager
description:
The Operations Manager – Exports is responsible for end-to-end management of procurement, inventory, logistics, freight forwarding, and export documentation. The role involves coordinating with suppliers for timely procurement and ensuring inventory availability aligned with export orders. The manager oversees warehouse operations, stock control, and dispatch planning to avoid shortages or delays. They plan and execute logistics, including container booking, shipment scheduling, and coordination with transporters, freight forwarders, and shipping lines.

The role ensures accurate preparation and verification of export documents such as invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and certificates of origin while maintaining compliance with international trade regulations and customs requirements.

Additionally, the Operations Manager negotiates freight rates, optimizes costs, tracks shipments, resolves operational issues, and coordinates with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely and efficient delivery of goods to global customers.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Manager I, Ops, Relay Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.  
Over the past 20+ years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. Through our entrepreneurial culture, Amazon has developed new technologies and products and enterprise services. APEX NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across Amazon’s transportation network. It ensures hassle-free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, Relay Ops plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
Risk and Compliance Monitoring Team (RCMT) within NOC is the centralized risk management function for RoW Surface Transportation. This team leads risk assessments across ST programs and develops tailored risk mitigation initiatives, programs, and audits to meet the needs of our business customers. RCMT is dedicated to preventing bad actors from exploiting Amazon services for illicit purposes and collaborates closely with legal, finance, and HR departments to conduct thorough investigations and take necessary actions against such actors. Our overarching vision is to ensure that bad actors never derive any benefit from Amazon by exploiting our policies. To achieve this, RCMT relies on sound judgment, technical expertise, and a robust risk management framework. We harness advanced technology to enhance our processes and develop projects, programs, and products that optimize Surface Transportation Operations across RoW countries — Brazil, Mexico, AMET (Egypt, KSA, South Africa, UAE), Japan, India, and Australia.  
The role operates on a rotational shift model (including nights and rotational week-offs) to provide round-the-clock risk coverage across time zones.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Process Expertise & Subject Matter Leadership — Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of Surface Transportation processes and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for risk management within the assigned RoW geographies. Maintain subject matter expertise specific to job functions and general industry awareness to provide informed recommendations to leadership.
* Risk Mitigation & Process Improvement — Apply risk-management best practices and methodologies to mitigate identified risk issues. Execute against established SOPs, identify and recommend opportunities for process improvement, draft SOP revisions, and conduct risk assessments for new process implementations to ensure vulnerabilities are identified and mitigated before go-live.
* Team Management & Development — Manage and supervise investigators — including workload assignment, quality review of investigation outputs, SLA adherence monitoring, and calibration. Mentor new hires and participate in the development and delivery of risk management training.
* Trend Analysis & Financial Impact Quantification — Conduct weekly and monthly trend analysis across assigned RoW geographies, including period-over-period comparisons and concentration analysis. Own the financial impact quantification framework — tracking cost leakage, cost avoidance, and cost savings attributable to risk interventions, coordinating with finance for periodic validation.
* Proactive Risk Identification & Expansion — Proactively identify new risk patterns through systematic analysis of investigation outputs and region-specific vulnerability assessments. Drive cross-pollination of risk management learnings into adjacent operational functions and workstreams to expand the program’s impact beyond core scope.
* Business Reviews & Escalation Management — Own and drive operational review cadences including business review content preparation and escalation management. Perform deep-dive analysis and draft COE based on identified deviations and recommend appropriate solutions to ensure leadership visibility into program health and outcomes.
* Investigation Oversight & Triage — Oversee the investigation triage process — reviewing flagged cases from monitoring dashboards, determining root cause, validating operational justifications, identifying gaps in controls and processes, and managing escalations in consultation with legal where required.
* Technology Partnership & Monitoring Enhancement — Partner with automation and technology teams on dashboard enhancements, detection logic refinement, and false positive reduction to continuously improve monitoring accuracy, coverage, and program efficiencies.
* Project Delivery & Execution — Develop appropriate milestones and launch project schedules to ensure timely and successful delivery of projects and standard work (e.g., audits/reviews, licensing).
* Program Alignment & Business Understanding — Ensure program alignment with the risk strategy, regulations, policies, and team objectives. Understand the business needs and workflows owned by your team including financial risk, controls, escalation paths, data sources, metrics, testing mechanisms, key dependencies, automation/tools, and risk-assessment methodologies.
* Stakeholder Management & Risk Culture — Maintain structured stakeholder cadences with country-specific leadership, operations execution, procurement, and carrier management teams across all assigned RoW geographies. Support risk reporting and risk-aware culture initiatives across RoW countries.

  
About the team  
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
* • Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level, SQL, and MS Access
* • Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
* • Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills to use data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases
* • Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement documents

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Director of Operations
description:
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As the Director of Operations, you work closely with the General Manager to oversee all operational departments, including front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, and other key departments, ensuring the hotel operates efficiently while maintaining the highest guest service standards. As a **Director of Operations** , you don’t just oversee all aspects of hotel operations – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

  

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

* **Leadership & Strategic Direction:** Lead operational departments to ensure alignment with hotel goals. Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute performance-driven strategies.
* **Operational Oversight:** Manage daily hotel operations for seamless guest experiences. Drive process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
* **Guest Experience:** Ensure service excellence across all guest interactions. Monitor feedback and implement initiatives to elevate satisfaction.
* **Financial Management:** Oversee departmental budgets and cost control. Analyze financial reports to improve profitability without compromising quality.
* **Team Development:** Motivate and develop department heads and teams. Promote continuous learning and a high-performance culture.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Coordinate with all departments for smooth operations. Align with sales, marketing, and revenue teams to support business goals.
* **Compliance & Risk:** Ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards. Manage risk through policy enforcement and emergency protocols.
* **Reporting & Analytics:** Deliver regular performance reports and leadership insights. Track KPIs to guide data-driven decisions.

  

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:

* A degree in hospitality management, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Proven leadership in senior hotel operations, preferably within luxury hospitality.
* Deep knowledge of hotel functions—front office, housekeeping, F&B, and engineering.
* Strong ability to lead, engage, and develop high-performing teams.
* Skilled in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and financial analysis.
* Familiar with hotel PMS and operational software.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with a cross-functional, guest-centric approach.
* Understanding of safety, regulatory standards, and risk management protocols.
* Willingness to work varied hours, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset.

  

**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Production lead – Printing & Production Operations
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Production Manager to oversee end-to-end print production operations, including vendor management, cost negotiation, quality control, delivery coordination, and production documentation.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of print deliverables, from understanding client requirements and print specifications to coordinating with printers, monitoring production timelines, inspecting finished materials, and ensuring timely delivery. The ideal candidate must have strong knowledge of paper grades, GSM, printing techniques, finishing processes, binding, packaging, and quality standards, along with excellent negotiation and coordination skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Print Production Management**

* Manage end-to-end production of print materials, including scientific journals, medical education modules, calendars, brochures, booklets, newsletters, certificates, conference materials, and other marketing collaterals.
* Understand production briefs, artwork, quantities, dimensions, paper specifications, finishing requirements, and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all print jobs are executed according to approved specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor production schedules and proactively address delays or operational challenges.

**2. Vendor & Printer Management**

* Identify, evaluate, onboard, and maintain relationships with printing vendors, paper suppliers, binding units, packaging vendors, and logistics partners.
* Coordinate with printers at every stage, from quotation and proof approval to production, inspection, dispatch, and delivery.
* Obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors and assess them based on cost, quality, reliability, and turnaround time.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms to achieve cost efficiencies.
* Maintain an updated vendor database, including capabilities, pricing, turnaround times, and performance records.

**3. Knowledge of Paper & Print Specifications**

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of paper types, grades, GSM, thickness, texture, opacity, and suitability for different print applications.
* Understand printing methods, including offset and digital printing, as well as lamination, UV coating, binding, folding, die-cutting, and other finishing techniques.
* Interpret technical specifications accurately, including dimensions, colour requirements, page counts, cover materials, binding styles, and packaging instructions.
* Verify that the paper and materials used by vendors match the approved specifications.
* Identify material substitutions or specification deviations before production and obtain approval wherever required.

**4. Costing & Budget Control**

* Prepare and evaluate print production estimates and quotations.
* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive pricing without compromising quality.
* Compare actual production costs against approved budgets and identify opportunities for savings.
* Track cost variations arising from changes in quantities, paper specifications, artwork, finishing, or delivery requirements.
* Ensure all commercial commitments and additional costs are documented and approved.

**5. Quality Control & Inspection**

* Inspect samples, colour proofs, paper quality, print alignment, colour consistency, binding, finishing, and overall workmanship.
* Ensure the final output matches the approved artwork, specifications, sample, and purchase order.
* Identify defects such as incorrect GSM, colour variations, misprints, poor binding, damaged copies, and quantity shortages.
* Coordinate corrective actions, reprints, replacements, or vendor claims wherever necessary.
* Ensure that only approved, quality-checked materials are dispatched to clients or designated locations.

**6. Delivery & Logistics Coordination**

* Ensure timely delivery of all print materials to clients, offices, warehouses, event venues, and other designated locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics partners for dispatch schedules, packaging, transportation, and delivery tracking.
* Monitor committed delivery dates and escalate potential delays well in advance.
* Verify delivered quantities against purchase orders and dispatch records.
* Ensure appropriate packaging, labelling, carton identification, and shipment documentation for every delivery.

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain complete documentation for every print job, including:
* Production briefs and approved specifications.
* Vendor quotations and cost comparisons.
* Purchase orders and work orders.
* Artwork and proof approvals.
* Paper specifications and quality inspection reports.
* Delivery challans, e-way bills wherever applicable, invoices, and dispatch records.
* Delivery confirmations, shortage reports, and quality-related claims.
* Maintain a production tracker covering job status, vendor, quantities, costs, deadlines, and delivery status.
* Provide regular updates to management and internal teams on production progress, delays, costs, and pending deliveries.
* Ensure records are accurate, traceable, and readily available for audits and financial reconciliation.

**8. Internal Coordination**

* Work closely with client servicing, medical education, design, accounts, procurement, and operations teams.
* Clarify technical requirements before releasing jobs to printers.
* Ensure approved artwork, specifications, quantities, and delivery instructions are communicated clearly to vendors.
* Coordinate invoice verification against purchase orders, agreed pricing, and actual deliveries.
* Take ownership of production-related issues and ensure timely resolution.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Printing Technology, Print Production, Graphic Arts, Operations, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in print production, commercial printing, publishing, or production operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of paper quality, GSM, printing processes, binding, finishing, and packaging.
* Proven experience in vendor coordination, quotation evaluation, and cost negotiation.
* Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory, and delivery management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation, with the ability to maintain production trackers and cost comparison sheets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, follow-up, and problem-solving skills.
* High attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to manage multiple jobs simultaneously.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery rate of print jobs.
* Adherence to approved print specifications and quality standards.
* Cost savings achieved through vendor negotiations.
* Reduction in printing errors, reprints, wastage, and material shortages.
* Accuracy and completeness of production documentation.
* Vendor performance and responsiveness.
* Timely resolution of production and delivery issues.
* Adherence to approved budgets and purchase order values.

Pay: ₹315,000.00 - ₹550,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:
**Updated:** Today  

**Location:** Madhapur, TS, India  

**Job ID:** 25111049


Not ready to apply?  

Join our Talent Network
**Description**


Manager, Clinical Operations
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.  

  

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  

  

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full\-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  

  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**

**Job Summary**
---------------


Accountable for and provides management support and direct supervision to Clinical Operations staff in the assigned areas including Site Selection support, site contracts support, regulatory/ethics submissions, site activities including site activation as well as On\-Site Monitoring and/or Central Monitoring through Study Close Out. Provides training, consultation and oversees metric compliance and quality related to operating activities of assigned staff to ensure project deliverables are met. Collaborates and oversees Clinical Operations Team to ensure fulfillment of customer requirements and compliance with related regulations. Supports senior management in operational level planning. May participate in business development presentations as a subject matter expert in Clinical Operations functions within the Company.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Line management of Clinical Operations staff, responsibilities including interviewing and selection, termination, professional development, performance appraisals, and employee counselling May be involved in assignment of project work and will review workloads for all direct reports. Manages staff by establishing goals that will increase knowledge and skill levels, and by delegating tasks commensurate with skill level.
* Review workload for all staff in reporting chain, participate in managing the resource availability for the assigned staff, providing support that projects are suitably resourced and staffing needs are identified in a timely fashion.
* Provide expert operational oversight and guidance to support prioritization of activities, review and monitor the work performed, metric compliance, and development of contingency plans, among others.
* Assist in recruiting new staff, including participation in interview process and new hire on boarding. Proactively work to ensure staff retention and turnover rates remain within expected levels.
* Ensure quality and adherence to Standard Operating Procedures/Work Instructions (SOP/WIs) and compliance with federal and local guidelines and ICH GCP. Ensure all staff follow required training and complete required documentation. Provide regular updates to management accordingly.
* Work closely within appropriate business unit/region to ensure staff performance on studies and correct deficiencies as identified by staff, customers, and auditors. Able to contribute to BU level process improvements. May provide business development support.
* May conduct several types of sign off and assessment visits to ensure Clinical Operations on\-site performance. Develop and oversee training plans to address performance deficiencies. Ensure staff adhere to training guidelines, training records maintenance, and individual and corporate training needs are identified and addressed.
* Organize and chair clinical staff meetings at regular intervals. Manage issues and provide follow up for action items requiring resolution.
* Facilitate and support project and team/country reviews with Clinical Operations staff, focusing on budget, schedule, and risk analysis. Use department systems, reports, and dashboards to identify performance issues, process gaps and monitor overall performance progress in line with departmental goals and metric targets. Oversee all quality control efforts of assigned teams.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, nursing degree, or equivalent related experience, plus extensive clinical research experience in a contract research organization, pharmaceutical or Biotechnology Company, including some time in a leadership capacity or equivalent combination of education, training and experience is required.
* **Preference to have experience in the industry, managing clinical portfolios, and in clinical operations.**
* **Strong experience in Regulatory \& Startup process.**
* **People management experience in m****anaging 15\-16 direct reports.**
* Extensive knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
* Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal, and change management skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade.
* Strong time management, technical and organizational skills. Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
* Knowledge of basic financial concepts as related to forecasting and budgeting. Understands project budgets.
* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace modern technologies.
* Ability to travel as necessary (up to 25%)

**Get to know Syneos Health**

  

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

\* Escalate manpower/performance issues to management.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Production Manager – SS sheet Metal Fabrication (Laser \& Press Brake Specialist)**

**Job Overview**

The Production Manager will oversee day\-to\-day operations of our advanced sheet metal fabrication floor, specifically managing high\-precision fiber laser cutting systems, laser welding machines, and CNC press brakes. This role focuses on optimizing machine uptime, ensuring tight dimensional tolerances, and leading a skilled team of operators and fabricators to meet delivery schedules.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Advanced Machine Utilization:** Maximize the efficiency and scheduling of fiber laser cutters, laser welding units, and multi\-axis CNC press brakes.
* **Production Scheduling:** Convert engineering drawings into daily production plans, balancing machine capacity to prevent bottlenecks at the bending and welding stations.
* **Technical Supervision:** Oversee nesting optimization to minimize sheet scrap and ensure correct bend allowances and weld parameters are used.
* **Quality Assurance:** Guarantee high\-precision standards for part dimensions, angles, and aesthetic weld quality (minimal distortion/burn through).
* **Maintenance Management:** Coordinate preventive maintenance for high\-value optics, laser chillers, gas delivery systems, and press brake tooling.
* **Team Leadership:** Manage, train, and upscale operators, fabricators, and technicians in safe laser handling and precision bending techniques.

**Core Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years of supervisory experience specifically within a CNC laser and press brake fabrication environment.
* **Technical Skills:** Strong proficiency in Auto CAD and deep understanding of sheet metal bend deductions.
* **Process Knowledge:** Expert understanding of laser gas mixes (Nitrogen/Oxygen), fiber laser optics, and modern laser welding fixture design. Exposure towards, ISO9001 systems , 5S Etc.
* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, or Manufacturing Engineering is preferred.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager, Solution Consulting Operations
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

We are looking for an Operations Manager \- Revenue and Solution Engineering to support our global GTM teams by delivering rapid, quality support to the global Solution Engineering, RevOps and Enablement teams. This role reports to the Senior Director of Services, with dotted\-lines to the Demo Engineering, RevOps and Revenue Enablement leaders, based in the US.
Who you are::
* 2\-5\+ years of leading high performing teams, ideally supporting sales functions
* 3\+ years working with SaaS products and technologies
* Demonstrated ability to work cross functionally
* Familiarity with SaaS businesses, metrics, goals, challenges
* Knowledge of technology in the sales tech, CRM or martech space
* Knowledge of how businesses and sales teams operate in our target market
* Proven strong executive leadership and decision making abilities
* Strong communication skills, ability to articulate and sell a vision internally and externally
* Strong execution skills and the ability to drive action and accountability
* Proven track record of hiring, developing and managing world\-class talent
* Experience working with and/or deploying Sales/Marketing/Service technologies.
* Working knowledge of CRM (Salesforce.com, Dynamics 365\).
* Entrepreneurial spirit and mindset, a focus on possibilities and not obstacle
* Proven ability to navigate ambiguity and change
* Proven track record of defining and optimizing processes
* Strong written and spoken English


What you'll be doing::
* Lead and oversee a team of Revenue Enablement, Revenue Operations and Demo Engineering


practitioners for daily local management.* Support the global Solution Engineering teams to deliver and maintain our standard and custom demo capability.
* Work with the global Enablement \& Operations team to establish the strategy, plan, and prioritization for process and tool enablement for internal teams, including both JIT and formal training strategies.
* Lead and oversee a small team of Revenue Operations system administrators supporting Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack.
* Scale Organizations, Processes and Operations. Work with global leaders to design, refine and innovate the service and processes as our company grows and evolves.
* Report on key metrics to indicate the success of global programmes.
* Develop a High Performing, High Engagement Team and Culture. Coach and develop your direct reports. Demonstrate very high emotional intelligence. Set and uphold the highest performance standards. Help colleagues “enjoy the ride” \- one of our core guiding principles.

Act as an ally and partner to colleagues in sister functions \- Product, Account Management, Marketing and others \- making decisions that take broader perspectives into account and providing insight into others’ decisions. Demonstrate a balanced, reasoned approach to conflict or differing priorities.
* Cultivate deep product knowledge. Gain deep knowledge, understanding, and experience with the Highspot platform and the value it provides businesses.

title: Senior EHS Operations Specialist/EHS Operations Lead
description:
**Job Title:** EHS Operations Lead


**Job Purpose:**

* Support the regional sites in order to ensure that the unique needs of the regional sites are understood and incorporated into the regional EH\&S Program.
* Provide leadership and hands\-on assistance to ensure a safe, secure and compliant workplace across the region, delivering outstanding EH\&S work process implementation, EH\&S performance and sustaining the License to Operate.
* Work in close partnership with EH\&S Leadership to ensure all work processes and resources are in place and properly utilized and aligned.
* Partner with Hub Leaders, EH\&S Center of Excellence (CoE) and Site Leadership to ensure appropriate, consistent implementation and maintenance of EH\&S work processes, best practices and most effective technologies; coordinate, align priorities and initiatives; drive initiatives /projects; audit the effectiveness of work processes and implementation; analyze performance data for trends and identify opportunities for improvement across the region.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Leadership \& Planning**

* Align personal and team EH\&S objectives with platform, regional, functional and site strategies and priorities.
* Collaborate closely with the EH\&S Leader to ensure plans are well communicated and supported.
* Assist Regional EH\&S Leader with providing environmental, Industrial Hygiene (IH), health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle leadership, support and expertise to the regional sites in a manner that is compatible with local issues and culture.
* Measure functional performance against goals, client expectations and work with EH\&S Leader to develop improvement plans.

**Work Process / Improvement**

* Acts as the regional focal point for EH\&S disciplines (environmental, IH, health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle, etc.).
* Partner with Operations / R\&D to leverage resources in order to drive EH\&S performance by utilizing all available EH\&S tools and work processes.
* Leads EH\&S regional improvement projects and initiatives.
* Coaches teams and individuals on EH\&S related tasks / activities and acts as the area resource for related EH\&S information on procedures, guidelines and standards.
* Provides hands\-on environmental, IH, health, safety, process safety/containment, and motor vehicle, EH\&S work process, standards and procedure assistance for assigned sites as indicated.
* Analyze and evaluate site EH\&S performance to identify and implement opportunities for improvement
* Supports site compliance with Corporate EH\&S Standards and Governmental Regulatory Requirements. Provide local input to Regional EH\&S Leader for regulatory strategies and advocacy.
* Supports regional self\-assessment, audit, regulatory compliance corrective action completion \& validation.
* Supports regional corporate Process Safety and Containment work process implementation.
* Ensures all appropriate IH programs, monitoring and health surveillance requirements are met.
* Facilitates incident investigations and root cause analyses.
* Support contractor companies with site EHS standards compliance.
* Assist site responses to geographic and/or site EH\&S / Emergency Response \& Security (ER\&S) issues (in concert with ER\&S Team) and crises that affect operations consistent with site, business, and corporate "license to operate" requirements.
* Supports Operating Discipline Management System (ODMS) EH\&S elements for the regional area sites.
* Implement, utilize, maintain and promote EH\&S management systems (ODMS).
* Ensures minimization of local customization of EH\&S / ER\&S management systems whenever possible and leads / champions management system reviews in order to drive continuous improvement.
* Supports cost\-effective delivery of EH\&S and ER\&S systems.
* Provide expertise and support for site environmental stewardship, waste management and remediation (where indicated).
* Ensure delivery of required EH\&S training.
* Lead, support, participate in and/or provide data for EH\&S audits / assessments / compliance initiatives.
* Collects, analyzes, calculates and inputs data for EH\&S reporting as necessary.
* Performs field observations and safety interventions.
* Completes documentation and facilitates waste characterizations.
* Monitors EH\&S compliance tasks completion.
* Initiates and/or supports Site Management of Change (MoC) for EH\&S matters as necessary.
* Links to EH\&S CoE to obtain clear interpretations on site\-specific regulatory processes, regulations, laws and associated procedures.
* As required, participates in the environmental, IH, health and safety related reviews and project support.
* Aligns with Information Technology (IT) initiatives, updates, cyber security processes and tools.
**Networks**

* Participate in global cross\-functional networks and leadership teams.
* Participate and support regional EH\&S network in order to drive improvement and facilitate change.
* Support community initiatives and/or communication networks in order to sustain the companies' public 'License to Operate'.
* Support EH\&S advocacy initiatives including proactive value\-based participation in relevant regional area industry, professional associations and external networks per the direction of the Regional EH\&S Leader.
**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s/Masters degree in an applicable scientific discipline is required; Professional certification where applicable
* 10\+ years of relevant industry experience, knowledge and skills in a manufacturing / industrial environment
* Fluent in English
* Willing to travel 30\-50%

**Knowledge \& Skills:**

* Demonstrated knowledge of all EH\&S work processes, in addition to regional site operations and processes
* Demonstrated knowledge of all regulatory, permit, and company requirements for the region, including audit requirements
* Working knowledge of ER\&S work processes
* Facilitates development and leveraging of expertise
* Self\-motivated, independent thinker and performer
* Ability to manage multiple projects and set priorities
* Works methodically and meets required deadlines. Well organized with a demonstrated ability to work without supervision
* Excellent consultation, facilitation, and influencing skills
* Excellent inter\-personal relationship skills to all levels in an organization
* Demonstrated open and clear communications and processes for issue resolution
* Demonstrated leadership and mentoring skills
* Excellent English / local language verbal and written communication skills. Excellent training and presentation skills
* Ability to analyze technical writing and regulations
* Broad experience with computers including word processing, spreadsheets, database and training/presentation software
